children: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said at the BRICS summit held over the weekend that the bloc should play an effective role in defending national sovereignty and territorial integrity, according to ETNet.

He said no power centre has the right to decide another country's fate, and argued that without security there can be no sustainable economy. Separately, Iranian parliament presidium spokesman Goudarzi said Iran's withdrawal from the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty is a "very realistic and feasible step." He added that trusting the United States is equivalent to agreeing to be deceived. Iran's Supreme National Security Council secretary Rezaei had earlier said Iran could quit the treaty and break a maritime blockade if the United States invaded the Persian Gulf or carried out any aggression against the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Iran Says BRICS Should Defend Sovereignty As Lawmaker Floats NPT Exit
